トップ ／ English

Mishima Chikusan, Kagoshima-Chuo Station

A Kagoshima-cuisine izakaya with private rooms, about three minutes on foot from JR Kagoshima-Chuo Station. Every table is in a private room with sunken (horigotatsu) seating, for two guests up to parties of 150.

Reservations by phone+81-99-813-8722

Open in Google Maps

What we serve

Local dishes of Kagoshima: Satsuma jidori chicken as sashimi and charcoal-seared tataki, Kurobuta black pork shabu-shabu and braised pork, kibinago (silver-stripe herring) as sashimi or fried, satsuma-age fish cakes, and bonito from Makurazaki seared over burning straw. Rice is cooked to order in individual kama pots. Shochu from Kagoshima is on the drinks list.

A menu book with English is available in the restaurant. Please note that several local specialities are served raw (chicken, fish, horse meat); tell the staff if you prefer cooked dishes only.

Set courses

All courses include 2.5 hours of all-you-can-drink (2 hours on Fridays, Saturdays and days before holidays). Prices are per person, tax included, for two or more guests. Each price is offered with or without a hot pot. Without drinks, each course is ¥1,000 less.

  • Fuyuyoi course (10 dishes, Sun–Thu and holidays only)¥3,500
  • Fuyukaze course (11 dishes)¥4,000
  • Fuyuutage course (12 dishes, most popular)¥4,500
  • Minori course (12 dishes, with seared wagyu)¥5,000
  • Irodori course (13 dishes)¥6,000
  • Kaori course (14 dishes, individually plated)¥8,000
  • Kiwami course (15 dishes, individually plated)¥10,000
  • Kagoshima Three Specialities course (with Kurobuta shabu-shabu)¥5,000

From 26 December to 3 January, courses are ¥500 more per person. Single dishes start at about ¥500; see the à la carte menu (Japanese).
